usage: codex_jobs.py status [-h] [--all] [--json] [--summary] [--job-id ID]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --all
  --json
  --summary  one-line summary; with --json, return {summary, jobs}
  --job-id ID  with --json only, read one job's fixed metadata without bodies or refresh
